links.comparator_used: Baseline heart rate estimation outputting every prediction without uncertainty-guided rejection
links.outcome: MAE and parity gaps across skin tones and sexes
links.effect: Uncertainty-guided rejection reduced MAE and effectively eliminated the skin tone and sex gaps; skin tone parity gap fell from 1.2 BPM to 0.0 BPM
links.quote: Baseline error was higher for participants with darker skin tones and for females; uncertainty-guided rejection reduced MAE and effectively eliminated these gaps (reducing parity gaps from 1.2 BPM to 0.0 BPM for skin tone).

links.comparator_used: Single-wavelength or fewer-wavelength PPG input sets
links.effect: Multi-wavelength fusion improved accuracy under motion; blue-green-red-IR achieved the lowest MAE (no numeric values given in the abstract)
links.quote: Multi-wavelength fusion improved accuracy under motion, with blue-green-red-IR achieving the lowest mean absolute error (MAE).
